title: Certify nine-call transposition path and star costs with spectators
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Supplies exact cut certificates proving that a three-edge transposition path or star costs **exactly nine paid coordinate-CNOT calls**, for every address dimension `n >= 4` and register count `R >= 3`. Free scalar register mixing and arbitrary restored dirty registers are allowed. The rational lower bounds are `25/3` and `57/7`; each excludes eight calls, and the nine-call diagonal words attain the target.

[Proof and model](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26117c30f9ab47bfcbc198e0edbe54ebbd57340e/research/swap-path-star-certificate/README.md), [explicit cut sets and weights](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26117c30f9ab47bfcbc198e0edbe54ebbd57340e/research/swap-path-star-certificate/CUTS.json), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26117c30f9ab47bfcbc198e0edbe54ebbd57340e/research/swap-path-star-certificate/RESULT.json), and [standalone verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/26117c30f9ab47bfcbc198e0edbe54ebbd57340e/research/swap-path-star-certificate/verify.py).

This is a scoped formal-group-algebra proof. It does not change the complete kappa calculation (`60403/20000000`). The tariff is one call per scalar rank-one idempotent coordinate-CNOT unit. There is no native construction or claim that these cuts are optimal within every cut family.

## Task and overlap

Certifies the scratch numerical path/star observations in [PR #4968](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4968). The earlier note already reports bounds near 8.33 and 8.14 and the nine-call path word; its LP certificates were not shipped. The contribution is exact public evidence, a solver-free replay and the uniform implication with spectators and dirty registers.

Base: `f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1`, priority 7. Main and the relevant sources were unchanged at submission. The handoff and live overlap were checked; the separate single-three-cycle proof has a different target. Sparse omitted notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/swap-path-star-certificate
```

Expected: `PASS_SWAP_PATH_STAR_CERTIFICATE path=9 star=9 no_new_kappa` in both commands, then `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Passed: exact rational paid loads; two independent counts over relative-order patterns and all 120 five-item orders; twelve formal diagonal endpoints across `n=4,5,6` and `R=3,5`; 108 single-call omissions; eight certificate controls. Four actual code mutations fail, including incorrect normalization, missing symmetry averaging and an omitted upper-word call. Exact source-pin checks, committed-byte checks and Git-free read-only optimized export replay pass.

No LP solver or search is required for replay. The optional full-history wrapper was not run in the shallow checkout; all four pins and the base ancestry were checked directly. No independent human or formal-kernel review, larger word census, selected replay or supplier admission is claimed.

## Credit

James Reed supplied the component cuts, numerical observations and path upper word in [PR #4968](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4968), and the averaged spectator method in [PR #4950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4950). The [retained source notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f259dabc7d70e0db8d6d36bfda888f008bbfecc1/research/swap-component-cut/README.md) credits Mihir Srivastava's spectator model and the earlier cut/register lineage. No predecessor code is imported. Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Repeated path/star batches on the same four coordinates may have a different additive cost. The fractional bounds do not round to nine per batch in general; no repeated-batch optimum is claimed.
